snippet.title: Painkiller - Launch Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Prepare for a brutal return to Purgatory in Painkiller. This modern reimagining of the classic action shooter brings fast‑paced co‑op gameplay, a twisted roguelike mode, and a vast arsenal of infernal weapons. Team up with friends to battle through procedurally generated arenas, face massive bosses, and uncover the dark secrets of the underworld. Available now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.
